## Rollback
- **Identified the issue**: `payments-worker` v3.4.0 (deployed this morning) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The prior release, **v3.3.0**, was healthy in production.
- **Rolled back** to **v3.3.0** across all production regions (human-approved during execution).

## Verification
- Post-rollback status confirms `payments-worker` is now on **v3.3.0** in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to **0.2%** — the downstream payments API errors should be resolving.

## Incident
- Opened **SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** ("payments-worker v3.4.0 causing payment API errors"), which **paged the on-call engineer**. The incident includes the error timeline, affected regions, and note that the rollback to v3.3.0 was performed; the v3.4.0 regression still needs investigation before a re-deploy.

No further action is needed from me unless you want me to track the fix for v3.4.0 once on-call has diagnosed it.
